title: Friends stand afar; conscience accuses
english: [[My friends and companions stand aloof from my plague >> Bible:Psalm 38:11]]. Better a weak believer who confesses than one who hides — conscience already prosecutes; [[all things are naked before him >> Bible:Hebrews 4:13]].
